caveat: Both development sets are development data, and neither is a test set. The corpus figure is the figure the submission reports; the combined figure is a sum over two sets that were drafted differently and share one template, so it is not a generalisation figure and does not replace the corpus number. The only generalisation figure the submission reports belongs to the sealed set, drafted without access to this repository and run exactly once after the 10 October freeze. Neither figure here is that figure.
note: Computed from recorded runs. No model call was made. A refused case is excluded from every figure rather than counted as a miss.
